description: This file defines a factory class 'ConnectorHtmlHelperFactory' that provides a method to instantiate a 'ConnectorHtmlHelper' object, choosing between main and custom implementation files based on file existence. It also contains licensing and project-specific documentation.

classes.name: ConnectorHtmlHelperFactory
classes.description: A factory class responsible for creating instances of 'ConnectorHtmlHelper' by selecting the appropriate helper file based on existence.

methods.name: build
methods.description: Static method that checks for the existence of a custom helper file and includes it; otherwise, includes the main helper file, then returns an instance of 'ConnectorHtmlHelper'.
